**Finding submitted: deviation (high severity, EXCLUSIVITY).**

- **Where:** § 3(i) Credit Bureau Information (p0042) — "Subject to the foregoing, Client shall order TrueLink a credit report on each borrower for which an underwriting approval is requested through a System using the Interface."
- **Why it deviates:** This is a requirements-style sole-supplier obligation on us for credit reports, running for the whole term with no performance-based exit. § 2(a) (p0022) preserves our freedom to license or develop competing software/services, but it does not reach credit report sourcing.
- **Not flagged:** the non-exclusive Interface licence (§ 2(a)) and the non-exclusive Credit Data licence we grant TrueLink (§ 8(d)) — neither restricts our purchasing freedom.
- **Redline (validated, preferred level):** ordering becomes permissive ("may, but shall not be obligated to") plus an express statement that nothing requires us to buy credit reports or other products exclusively from TrueLink. Comment offers the fallback: credit reports only, 12 months, terminating automatically on failure to meet the § 3 performance standards.
